{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean `revenue`: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
data['revenue_float'] = pd.to_numeric(data['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Replace -1 in `customer_age` with NaN
data['customer_age'] = data['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment to check for confounding
channel_segment = pd.crosstab(data['channel'], data['customer_segment'])
print("Channel vs Customer Segment:")
print(channel_segment)

# Compute conversion rate by channel and segment
conversion_by_channel_segment = data.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print("\nConversion rate by channel and segment:")
print(conversion_by_channel_segment)

# Extract conversion rates for email and paid_search within each segment
email_loyal = conversion_by_channel_segment.loc[(conversion_by_channel_segment['channel'] == 'email') & (conversion_by_channel_segment['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'), 'converted'].iloc[0]
email_new = conversion_by_channel_segment.loc[(conversion_by_channel_segment['channel'] == 'email') & (conversion_by_channel_segment['customer_segment'] == 'new'), 'converted'].iloc[0]
email_returning = conversion_by_channel_segment.loc[(conversion_by_channel_segment['channel'] == 'email') & (conversion_by_channel_segment['customer_segment'] == 'returning'), 'converted'].iloc[0]

paid_search_loyal = conversion_by_channel_segment.loc[(conversion_by_channel_segment['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (conversion_by_channel_segment['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'), 'converted'].iloc[0]
paid_search_new = conversion_by_channel_segment.loc[(conversion_by_channel_segment['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (conversion_by_channel_segment['customer_segment'] == 'new'), 'converted'].iloc[0]
paid_search_returning = conversion_by_channel_segment.loc[(conversion_by_channel_segment['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (conversion_by_channel_segment['customer_segment'] == 'returning'), 'converted'].iloc[0]

# Compute differences
diff_loyal = email_loyal - paid_search_loyal
diff_new = email_new - paid_search_new
diff_returning = email_returning - paid_search_returning

# Print the differences
print(f"\nDifference in conversion rate (email - paid_search) by segment:")
print(f"Loyal: {diff_loyal:.6f}")
print(f"New: {diff_new:.6f}")
print(f"Returning: {diff_returning:.6f}")

# Compute average difference
avg_diff = (diff_loyal + diff_new + diff_returning) / 3
print(f"Average difference: {avg_diff:.6f}")

# Final answer: The campaign was not successful
# The differences are all negative, so email underperformed in every segment
# The average difference is negative
print(f"\nFinal conclusion: The campaign was not successful because email had lower conversion rates than paid_search in every customer segment.")"}
